name: antigravity-token-counter
description: Real-time input and output token counter for Google Antigravity IDE with cost estimation and analytics.

commands.title: Antigravity Token Counter: Show Stats & Menu
Antigravity Token Counter: Reset Current Session
Antigravity Token Counter: Export Token Usage Report
Antigravity Token Counter: Rescan Active Conversation

antigravityTokenCounter.brainPath.description: Custom absolute path to Antigravity brain directory (Leave empty for default ~/.gemini/antigravity-ide/brain).

enumDescriptions: ⚡ Auto-Detect Model (Automatically detect from conversation logs)
🔥 Gemini 3.7 Flash — Fast & Medium ($0.75/1M In, $3.75/1M Out)
🔥 Gemini 3.6 Flash — Fast & Medium ($0.75/1M In, $3.75/1M Out) [Intro price until Dec 2026]
⚡ Gemini 3.5 Flash — Fast & Medium ($1.50/1M In, $9.00/1M Out)
💎 Gemini 3.1 Pro — High reasoning, Low speed ($2.00/1M In, $12.00/1M Out)
🤖 Claude Sonnet 4.6 (Thinking) — Current Anthropic workhorse ($3.00/1M In, $15.00/1M Out)
🧠 Claude Opus 4.6 (Thinking) — Highest capability ($5.00/1M In, $25.00/1M Out)
Custom Pricing — defined by fields below
antigravityTokenCounter.modelPricing.description: Model pricing profile to estimate token usage cost. Current Antigravity models are listed first.

antigravityTokenCounter.customInputCostP.description: Custom Input token cost in USD per 1M tokens.

antigravityTokenCounter.customOutputCost.description: Custom Output token cost in USD per 1M tokens.

antigravityTokenCounter.statusBarFormat.description: Display format for the status bar item.

antigravityTokenCounter.pollingIntervalM.description: Polling interval in milliseconds to check for active conversation changes.

scripts.test: node -e "require('esbuild').buildSync({entryPoints:['test/testTokenizer.ts'], outfile:'out/testTokenizer.js', bundle:true, platform:'node', external:['vscode']})" && node out/testTokenizer.js
